title: How can i use the my absolute urls in algolia?
body: Currently, the relative URLs are getting appended in the base url. But, if we need the absolute urls to be used how can is use it from hit data.

comments.body: @Haroenv - Can you please help me out with this?

I don't understand your question, please give a sandbox. We have a template available for that purpose [here](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/tree/templates/instantsearch.js). Thanks!

@Haroenv - As per your sandbox "**https://xo94wl403z.csb.app/**" is your base URL so, if I want to redirect the user to another page after clicking on hit i.e "**Amazon - Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote - Black**". At that time whatever the URL of that hit is, it gets appended to the base URL for example:- If my URL for that hit (specific entity) is:- "https://codesandbox.io" Once I click on that hit, Url gets appended to the base URL https://xo94wl403z.csb.app/https://codesandbox.io like this. I just don't want that to happen. **NOTE:- This Happens when i use template in another file like,** I have created ``` ``` And geting this template using ``` item :document.getElementById('hit-template-row').innerHTML ```

Why is the `href` in your example https://www.algolia.com/users/sign_in instead of the link you want to go to? e.g. if the url you put in Algolia are complete urls, then do:

```
<a href="{{href}}">
```

or whatever the name of the attribute is. If the URL is relative, then:

```
<a href="https://base.com/{{path}}">
```

Is that what you meant?

@Haroenv - Yes i tried the same. But this works when i create my template of hit js

```
instantsearch.widgets.hits({
	container: '#hits',
	escapeHTML: false,
	templates: {
		item: "**Hit design**"
```

But when I create my **Hit design** (template) in another Html file within the script tags, and accessing that as given below It does not work.


```
instantsearch.widgets.hits({
	container: '#hits',
	escapeHTML: false,
	templates: {
item :document.getElementById('hit-template-row').innerHTML
```
I don't understand the issue, those should behave the same. Could you try to reproduce the exact issue in code please?
